Question 4
?

Let y=∑n=0∞anxn be a series solution to the equation xy+9y′=0.

What is the recurrence relation for the coefficients an, where n=1,2,3,…

a
an+1=an−19(n+1)
b
an+1=an−19n+1
c
an+1=−an−19(n+1)
d
an+1=−9an−1(n+1)
e
an+1=−an−19n+1
Submit
